info.title: Deployz vendor API
info.description: Build releases and deploy them to your customers from your own pipeline. Create an API key on the API keys page of the Deployz dashboard, and send it in the header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. A key has read or deploy permission and works only while the person who created it is an owner or an admin. Deploy, restart and rollback answer 202 with a job. Poll the job until its state is succeeded, failed or cancelled. Every answer is `{ success, message, data, request_id }`, except this document. Every error is `{ success: false, error: { code, message }, request_id }`. The `request_id` is also the `X-Request-Id` header: quote it when you ask for support. A key can make 120 requests a minute. Over the limit the answer is 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

get.summary: List the releases of an application and their build status

post.summary: Start a release build from a commit
post.description: Needs deploy permission. Only one release of an application builds at a time. Send the same version and commit again to get the same release (200). The same version with another commit answers 409 RELEASE_VERSION_EXISTS. Send the full 40-character commit SHA: Deployz looks up a shorter SHA on GitHub, which can answer 404 COMMIT_NOT_FOUND, 429 GITHUB_RATE_LIMITED or 502 GITHUB_COMMITS_FETCH_FAILED.

200.description: The release already exists for this version and commit.

example.message: Release already exists for this version and commit

201.description: The release. Its status is building.

409.description: The request conflicts with the current state. Codes: RELEASE_VERSION_EXISTS, RELEASE_BUILD_IN_PROGRESS, GITHUB_NOT_CONNECTED.

422.description: A required build value has no value. Code: BUILD_CONFIGURATION_MISSING. `error.details.keys` lists the variable names. Enter the values in the configuration of the application in the Deployz dashboard.

post.summary: Deploy a release to one deployment
post.description: Needs deploy permission. The release must be ready. One operation at a time runs on a deployment: another answers 409 DEPLOYMENT_BUSY.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A value your pipeline chooses for this operation. Repeat the request with the same value and release to get the same job. The same value with another release answers 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

200.description: The same deploy already exists: it is queued or running, or it was started with the same Idempotency-Key.

Location.description: The path of the job to poll.

example.message: Deploy is already queued or running
